properties.name: Netcraft Domain Detection - Preemptive disruption
properties.description:
Identifies Domain Detection results whose tag `display_name` is `Preemptive Disruption`.
Uses NetcraftDomainDetection_Latest so the same DomainResultId alerts once per window.
properties.query:
NetcraftDomainDetection_Latest
| where IngestedAt > ago(15m)
| where tostring(Tags) contains "Preemptive Disruption"
| extend
    DNSDomain = Hostname,
    RiskCategory = tostring(Risk.category)
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    EventId,
    DomainResultId,
    Subject,
    Hostname,
    DNSDomain,
    Risk,
    RiskCategory,
    ChangeType,
    CloudEventType,
    Tags,
    IpAddresses,
    Registrar,
    Domain,
    AreaId

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: Domain {{Hostname}} ({{DomainResultId}}) is tagged Preemptive Disruption with risk {{RiskCategory}}. See the ChangeType custom detail for the change that triggered it.
